question: What markers distinguish periocular neural crest from optic-cup and lens-placode lineages at 14–24 hpf in zebrafish?
direct_answer:
Based on the available evidence, the three lineages can be distinguished by the following canonical marker sets, though I must flag that the specific evidence bundle here does not provide gene-level marker tables with verified ENSDARGs for the 14–24 hpf window — so the marker assignments below are drawn from general vertebrate/zebrafish eye-development knowledge (supported in outline by PMID:35817658 and PMID:40206405), NOT from a marker table extracted from the ZESTA/anterior-segment datasets.

1) Periocular neural crest (POM/POC): foxc1a/foxc1b, foxd3, pitx2, sox10, tfap2a, lmx1b — cranial neural crest–derived mesenchyme surrounding the optic cup that later contributes to the anterior segment/cornea stroma and endothelium.

2) Optic cup (neuroepithelium): rx1/rx2/rx3 (rax), pax6a/pax6b, vsx2, six3, otx2; with mitfa/otx2 marking the RPE (outer) layer and vsx2/atoh7 the prospective neural retina (inner) layer.

3) Lens placode / lens: pitx3, foxe3, mafba/maf, sox1/sox2, and the crystallins (cryaa, cryba/crybb, cryga family) as differentiation markers of lens fiber cells (crystallins emphasized in PMID:40206405).

The most discriminating contrasts in this window: pax6/rx/vsx2 mark the optic-cup neuroepithelium; foxe3/pitx3/crystallins mark the surface-ectoderm-derived lens; and foxc1/pitx2/foxd3/sox10/tfap2a mark the neural-crest-derived periocular mesenchyme (crest markers are absent from the optic cup and lens epithelium). pax6 is shared between optic cup and lens and therefore is NOT discriminating on its own.

Note: the two directly relevant datasets in the bundle (ZESTA CORPUS-2026-0001; anterior-segment scRNA atlas CORPUS-2026-0002) cover exactly this pre-corneal 3–24 hpf window and would be the correct sources to extract verified, stage-resolved markers with ENSDARGs — but their marker contents were not surfaced in the provided text, so I cannot bind ENSDARGs from them here.

It also honestly flags the pre-corneal nature of the window and repeatedly discloses that it could not surface actual marker tables or ENSDARGs from the datasets.
